destination.title: Calabi–Yau geometry, moduli spaces and effective physics
destination.question: How do Calabi–Yau geometry, moduli and degeneration data organize effective theories, physical spectra, quantum phases and consistency questions?
destination.summary: A broad research family with distinct period, distance, singularity, symmetry, arithmetic, stabilization and metric questions. The packet supplies numerical candidate membership but no original prose scope to endorse verbatim. The proposed scope is a new organization requiring independent review.

systems: Calabi–Yau geometries and their string, M-theory and F-theory compactifications
Heterotic dual descriptions and explicitly related special-geometric or conformal theories
targets: Singularities, topology change and connected vacua
Charged states, black objects and symmetries
regimes: Threefold, fourfold and other explicitly specified settings
Classical, perturbative, nonperturbative and numerical treatments
assumptions: Validity conditions remain local to each source question.
Conjectural towers, consistency criteria, uplift mechanisms and diagnostic bounds are questions or source claims, not accepted family-wide premises.
conventions: Keep dimensions, supersymmetry, multiplet sectors, charge bases and approximation orders distinct.
Source-scoped singleton access does not establish atomicity or cross-source uniqueness.
includes: Numerical internal metrics and explicit stabilization constructions
Mathematical questions about Calabi–Yau moduli geometry
Auxiliary or rigid theories where the supplied material explicitly compares them with compactification geometry
excludes: Automatic inclusion of G2 cone assumptions as Calabi–Yau results
String-star thermodynamics without a supplied Calabi–Yau connection
Treating Calabi–Yau motives in amplitudes as evidence of a compactification system
Universal conclusions inferred from shared terminology or source-object graph edges

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Which ten-dimensional equations are retained, assumed, or lost when the generalized functional is restricted to conventional Calabi–Yau light modes?

sources.title: Special Points of Inflation in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Which special loci in Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space support approximately shift-symmetric axions, and which toy inflationary potentials arise when background fluxes break those symmetries?

sources.title: Global Embedding of Fibre Inflation Models

evidence.text: Can fibre-inflation potentials be realized in explicit type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifolds with suitable topology, branes, tadpole conditions and Kähler-modulus stabilization, while including string-loop and higher-derivative corrections?

sources.title: Infinite Distance Networks in Field Space and Charge Orbits

evidence.text: How do the splitting and commuting-triple algorithms work for two different approaches to the same large-complex-structure intersection?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Which decompactification limits of Calabi–Yau Kähler parameters lead to infinite distance and identifiable charge towers in the four-dimensional vector-multiplet sector?

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Do degeneration limits of one-parameter Calabi–Yau moduli spaces contain infinitely many stable BPS states whose masses decrease exponentially with distance? This window examines light charge subspaces, possible decay channels, and a second M-point description.

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: What string and effective dimension arise when an Abelian-surface fiber shrinks at finite Calabi–Yau volume? The wrapped M5 is identified with a Type II string; equal elliptic-area scalings define the genuine product-fiber Type T4 limit.

sources.title: Extremal $1/2$ Calabi–Yau $3$-folds and six-dimensional F-theory applications

evidence.text: The paper asks whether degeneration into 1/2 Calabi–Yau building blocks has a physical interpretation and whether analogous constructions exist with tensor counts other than seven. A possible connection to swampland conditions is posed as an open question.

sources.title: Moduli spaces of Calabi-Yau $d$-folds as gravitational-chiral instantons

evidence.text: The physical data are the complex-structure moduli and period monodromy of a compact Calabi–Yau compactification. A projected period map supplies the candidate matter field on moduli space, while the Weil–Petersson metric supplies the candidate gravitational field.

sources.title: Moduli space holography and the finiteness of flux vacua

evidence.text: Can boundary algebraic data reconstruct the asymptotic geometry of Calabi–Yau moduli spaces and exclude infinite sequences of flux vacua approaching their boundaries?

sources.title: State counting on fibered CY-3 folds and the non-Abelian Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can Calabi–Yau geometry reconstruct Heterotic supersymmetric indices and conjectural refined BPS counts, including higher-rank and CHL examples, and establish the non-Abelian sublattice weak gravity conjecture in these compactifications?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures and infinite flop chains

evidence.text: Which part of the compactification moduli space permits a controlled geodesic analysis? The paper isolates the fixed-volume vector sector, whose geometry is claimed to be protected while the overall volume belongs to a different multiplet sector.

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: How can general asymptotic periods be modeled without solving a separate geometry-specific differential system?

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Can the authors' asymptotic II-class period models accommodate the Seiberg–Witten degeneration of the K3-fibered degree-12 weighted-projective Calabi–Yau? The comparison starts from an imported six-component Picard–Fuchs solution vector.

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: How are complex-structure degenerations represented as axion–saxion limits with explicit small exponential parameters?

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Which boundary data describe a simultaneous conifold and large-complex-structure degeneration? The source treats two divisor configurations sharing a type-IV2 intersection and chooses a six-dimensional split Deligne basis for constructing their asymptotic periods.

sources.title: Modular curves and the refined distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can increasing the degree 2N of a K3 fiber produce parametrically large finite directions in hybrid phases, delaying the exponentially light distance-conjecture tower and challenging the refined distance conjecture? Does the Calabi–Yau landscape bound N?

sources.title: Geodesics in the extended Kähler cone of Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: How do geodesics approach Kähler-cone boundaries and continue across flop transitions for Calabi–Yau threefolds with h^{1,1}=2, and what do infinite flop sequences imply for the distance conjecture?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in asymptotic flux compactifications

evidence.text: How does the general boundary algorithm operate on an explicit two-modulus compactification? The chosen degree-eight mirror supplies six-dimensional matrices and a nontrivial ordered hierarchy.

sources.title: Level crossings, attractor points and complex multiplication

evidence.text: Why do scalar-Laplacian eigenvalues become heavier or lighter as complex structure varies, and what distinguishes their crossing loci? Can the torus connection to complex multiplication extend to higher-dimensional Calabi–Yau attractors?

sources.title: Beyond large complex structure: quantized periods and boundary data for one-modulus singularities

evidence.text: How can periods near one-modulus conifold and K-point boundaries be expressed in an integral basis, and how do their model-dependent coefficients encode degenerate geometry, arithmetic information and supergravity couplings?

sources.title: Stable non-BPS black holes and black strings in five dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-parameter Calabi-Yau compactifications admit stable doubly extremal non-BPS black holes and multiple attractors for identical charges, and what corresponding structures occur for black strings?

sources.title: Charting the complex structure landscape of F-theory

evidence.text: Which one-parameter Calabi–Yau fourfold period systems can occur over the thrice-punctured sphere with prescribed large-complex-structure and conifold punctures, and what phases and physical couplings arise at the remaining puncture?

sources.title: Attractors, Geodesics, and the Geometry of Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Can attractor flows connect conjectures about marked-moduli-space geodesic uniqueness to Laplacian spectra and BPS states, and what can toroidal, five-dimensional Calabi–Yau and quintic examples establish?

sources.title: Holes in Calabi-Yau Effective Cones

evidence.text: Which integral classes inside Calabi–Yau effective cones lack holomorphic representatives, how do these holes organize, and how can their minimum four-cycle volumes constrain nonperturbative physics?

sources.title: Towards Systematics of Calabi-Yau Landscape for String Cosmology

evidence.text: How can systematic classification of Calabi–Yau divisor and curve topologies identify geometries suitable for global moduli stabilization and inflation, and how can assisted fibre inflation address geometric field-range constraints?

sources.title: Massless black holes and conifolds in string theory

evidence.text: Can massless Ramond–Ramond black holes resolve conifold singularities in type II Calabi–Yau moduli-space effective theories, and how can the required quantum effects survive as the string coupling vanishes?

sources.title: Black hole condensation and the unification of string vacua

evidence.text: Can light black-hole hypermultiplets and their condensation provide smooth physical transitions between topologically distinct type II Calabi–Yau vacua, connecting their moduli spaces and extending mirror symmetry?

sources.title: CFT's from Calabi-Yau four folds

evidence.text: Which vacua, BPS domain walls, effective superpotentials, and infrared conformal theories arise near isolated Calabi-Yau four-fold singularities once flux and space-filling brane data are specified?

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Do lower-dimensional theories with eight supercharges possess an analogue of automatic enhancement beyond compactified elliptic examples? The absence of pure U(1)-charged Higgs fields motivates this question, but a universal constraint on general Calabi–Yau threefolds is not derived.

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Track the involution through the pairing integrands, compare their parity with the volume form, and normalize a covering-space integral by its overcounting factor. The explicit potential formulas and component action of α are needed to reproduce the sign check.

sources.title: Special Points of Inflation in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Analyze Jordan forms and conditions (T^p−I)^m=0 to relate monodromy eigenvalue degeneracies to logarithmic powers. Compute K and W from the resulting periods and evaluate leading scalar-potential terms.

sources.title: Global Embedding of Fibre Inflation Models

evidence.text: Scan Kreuzer–Skarke toric data and triangulations for the required fibration and shrinkable divisors. Use intersection polynomials, divisor Euler characteristics and cohomCalg computations to identify divisor topology and rewrite the volume.

sources.title: Infinite Distance Networks in Field Space and Charge Orbits

evidence.text: Decompose δ using the first real splitting, evaluate the weight-three polynomial, and act on the filtration. A lone component of bidegree (−3,−3) produces no ζ correction.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Bound the norm of dK, apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the path velocity, and integrate its total variation. The operation avoids geodesic solutions and supplies a lower bound for paths within the controlled metric region.

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Given a proposed BPS decay, sum its complex central charges and compare the initial mass with the sum of daughter masses. Nonalignment excludes the channel. Alignment locates a possible marginal-stability wall but still requires quantized charges and actual daughter states.

sources.title: Center Symmetry Breaking in Calabi–Yau Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the breaking of Abelian center one-form symmetries by massive BPS states be quantified in Calabi–Yau compactifications, and does it become order one by the Planck or species scale? The paper studies this dynamical proposal using simplified four- and five-dimensional examples.

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in type II string theory

evidence.text: How do curves of Calabi–Yau singularities generate nonabelian gauge symmetry in four-dimensional Type II compactifications, and do their geometric transitions, periods and topological amplitudes match the proposed light-soliton theory?

sources.title: Distribution of flux vacua around singular points in Calabi-Yau moduli space

evidence.text: Is the Ashok–Douglas flux-vacuum index density locally integrable near singular loci of Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space, including conifolds, geometric-engineering boundaries and embedded Argyres–Douglas points?

sources.title: The Kreuzer-Skarke Axiverse

evidence.text: How do Kähler-cone constraints at large Picard number affect cycle volumes, control of the α′ expansion, and the masses and geometric field ranges of axions in Calabi–Yau compactifications?

sources.title: Curvature divergences and gravity decoupling in Calabi-Yau rigid limits

evidence.text: Which vector-multiplet subsectors actually decouple from gravity near Calabi–Yau degeneration limits, and when does divergent moduli-space scalar curvature diagnose this decoupling?

sources.title: Bulk reconstruction in moduli space holography

evidence.text: Can constrained near-boundary solutions of an auxiliary two-dimensional sigma-model be reconstructed uniquely from algebraic Sl(2,R) boundary data, without assuming a geometric realization, and then related to asymptotic Calabi–Yau periods?

sources.title: Hodge Structures of Complex Multiplication Type from Rational Conformal Field Theories

evidence.text: Under which boundary-state and Galois-compatibility assumptions does rational N=(2,2) CFT produce CM-type rational Hodge structures, and how do these relate to Calabi–Yau middle cohomology?

sources.title: String theory on Calabi-Yau manifolds

evidence.text: Introduce how Calabi-Yau compactification replaces classical geometry with string quantum geometry, particularly through mirror symmetry, connected conformal-theory phases and physically smooth topology change.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in asymptotic flux compactifications

evidence.text: What explicit operator data enter the sl(2)-approximated Hodge star for the paper's linear-scenario example? Appendix A provides weight, lowering, and boundary-star matrices, while the geometric interpretation and asymptotic approximation formula lie outside this window.

sources.title: Moduli spaces of Calabi-Yau $d$-folds as gravitational-chiral instantons

evidence.text: Can effective couplings of a theory known to arise from quantum gravity obey an additional gravitational field theory on their own moduli space? The paper tests this question using the Weil–Petersson metric and period-map data of Calabi–Yau compactifications.

sources.title: Asymptotic String Compactifications: Periods, flux potentials, and the swampland

evidence.text: How can asymptotic Hodge theory organize Calabi–Yau periods and physical couplings near degenerations, enabling calculations of weak-gravity bounds and flux-moduli stabilization beyond large complex structure?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What geometric degeneration accompanies a gauge symmetry becoming global in an elliptically fibered Calabi–Yau compactification? The supplied limit sends the gauge-support volume to infinity along a nef isotropic direction of the base Kähler cone.

sources.title: Infinite Distance Networks in Field Space and Charge Orbits

evidence.text: How can the towers expected at infinite distance be identified throughout a Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space, including intersections of singular divisors and different paths approaching those intersections?

sources.title: The desert and the swampland

evidence.text: How does topology affect the largest protected gap when the number of moduli can vary widely? Eight-supercharge Calabi–Yau compactifications provide a much larger set of theories than the higher-supersymmetry examples.

sources.title: A Property of Geodesics in Special Kähler Geometry

evidence.text: Which complete geodesics in the rigid special Kähler geometry of 4d N = 2 QFT are stable, can distinct such geodesics intersect repeatedly or close, and what weaker restrictions follow for gravitational Weil–Petersson geometry?

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: How do complex-structure degenerations constrain charged BPS states and electric BPS black-hole extremality in four-dimensional N=2 Calabi–Yau compactifications?

sources.title: On the geometry of moduli space of polarized Calabi-Yau manifolds

evidence.text: Are integrals of Weil-Petersson curvature invariants finite and rational on noncompact moduli spaces of polarized Calabi-Yau manifolds?

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Does approaching each infinite-distance boundary in these Calabi–Yau moduli spaces produce infinitely many stable particles with exponentially decreasing masses?

sources.title: Exact results for N=2 compactifications of heterotic strings

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional N=2 heterotic compactifications admit type II Calabi–Yau duals, allowing exact quantum moduli geometry to be inferred from the other description, and how can apparently different heterotic vacua be connected?

sources.title: Special Geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which special Kähler geometries admit quantum-consistent UV completions, and can their arithmetic structure unify and strengthen the N=2 swampland conditions?

sources.title: Time reversal and CP invariance in Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Do quantum corrections, scalar expectation values and flux backgrounds preserve time reversal or CP in type II Calabi–Yau compactifications, and what distinguishes the symmetry-preserving loci?

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Which exponential corrections are required for consistent asymptotic Calabi–Yau periods, and how can boundary Hodge data construct period models usable in string effective theories?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Which asymptotic shapes of a Calabi–Yau three-fold allow some internal cycles to expand and others to collapse at finite total volume?

sources.title: Infinite Distances and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How does complex-structure degeneration affect R-R axion couplings? Classical reduction expresses the kinetic metric through the Hodge star on internal three-forms, making asymptotic Hodge theory directly relevant.

sources.title: Global symmetry-breaking and generalized theta-terms in Type IIB EFTs

evidence.text: Which electromagnetic one-form and axionic zero-form global symmetries can emerge in Type IIB Calabi–Yau EFTs near complex-structure boundaries, and how do generalized theta terms and assumed charged objects remove them?

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: How can a period vector retain the complete three-form geometry needed by four-dimensional Calabi–Yau compactifications?

sources.title: Two-dimensional black hole and singularities of CY manifolds

evidence.text: What conformal-field-theory degeneration occurs at conifold singularities of Calabi–Yau threefolds and ADE singularities of K3/ALE spaces, and how does it relate to two-dimensional black holes, fivebranes, and noncritical topological strings?

sources.title: WEAKLY-coupled IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can restricted-flux type-IIA Calabi–Yau compactifications reproduce LARGE-volume phenomenology through exponentially weak coupling, controlled moduli stabilization and a tunable de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: The Symplectic structure of N=2 supergravity and its central extension

evidence.text: How does special geometry organize the moduli-dependent electric and magnetic charges, central extension, and charge sum rules of four-dimensional N=2 supergravity, including its Type IIB Calabi–Yau realization?

sources.title: Curvature divergences in 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravity

evidence.text: When does the vector-moduli-space scalar curvature of M-theory Calabi–Yau compactifications diverge, and what does its divergence reveal about sectors decoupling from gravity and their UV rigid completions?

sources.title: CYJAX: A package for Calabi-Yau metrics with JAX

evidence.text: How can a modular numerical package efficiently approximate Calabi-Yau metrics across complex-structure moduli, helping address the missing metric information needed for low-energy couplings in string compactifications?

sources.title: Attractors are not algebraic

evidence.text: Does the Hodge-theoretic attractor condition force algebraic moduli for Calabi–Yau varieties, as proposed in the higher-dimensional analogue of Moore's threefold Attractor Conjecture?

sources.title: Seeking de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Review how type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifolds can stabilise moduli and realise de Sitter vacua, particularly through purely perturbative corrections, and which geometric requirements permit a concrete global embedding.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures and infinite flop chains

evidence.text: Do topology-changing flop trajectories provide large physical moduli distances without a tower of light states? The relevant distinction is between repeated descriptions of finitely many Calabi–Yau geometries and genuinely infinitely many isomorphism classes.

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Cutoff from Axions: A Type IIB Landscape Study

evidence.text: Does the proposed bound M_s ≲ 2π√S f survive in Type IIB Calabi–Yau compactifications with multiple axions, especially near Kähler-cone boundaries where electric–magnetic co-scaling fails?

sources.title: Infinite Distance Networks in Field Space and Charge Orbits

evidence.text: How do infinite-distance loci in Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space intersect, and can their monodromy and Hodge-theoretic data identify candidate towers for the Swampland Distance Conjecture, including the dependence on approach paths?

sources.title: Calabi-Yau period geometry and restricted moduli in Type II compactifications

evidence.text: How do Frobenius structure, monodromy and moduli-space symmetries organise Calabi–Yau periods and determine supersymmetric flux vacua on restricted moduli spaces? Applications also include canonical differential systems for Feynman integrals.

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: When do hyperbolic toy geometries describe actual infinite-distance regions of compactification moduli spaces?

sources.title: Moduli-dependent KK towers and the swampland distance conjecture on the quintic Calabi-Yau manifold

evidence.text: Do lightening and crossings persist for forms, other moduli directions, and other Calabi–Yau constructions, and can the crossing pattern be predicted?

sources.title: Calabi-Yau fourfolds for M theory and F theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which explicit Calabi-Yau fourfold deformation families support M- and F-theory compactifications, and how do their topology, instanton divisors, elliptic degenerations, transitions and quantum cohomology encode effective-theory properties?

Which vacua, BPS domain walls, effective superpotentials, and infrared conformal theories arise near isolated Calabi-Yau four-fold singularities once flux and space-filling brane data are specified?

sources.title: From Linear SUSY to Constrained Superfields

evidence.text: How can ordinary superspace describe Goldstinos and other surviving light particles after spontaneous SUSY breaking, identify their microscopic interpolating operator, and distinguish universal leading interactions from corrections?

sources.title: Metastable spontaneous breaking of N=2 supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can rigid N=2 supersymmetry break spontaneously in metastable vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms, using only one hypermultiplet and one Abelian vector multiplet? What scalar-mass bounds follow, and what can be inferred about an extension to de Sitter supergravity?

sources.title: Cosmology with Nilpotent Superfields

evidence.text: Can replacing the goldstino chiral multiplet by a nilpotent multiplet simplify supergravity inflation and vacuum uplifting, remove sgoldstino stabilization, and connect these constructions to Volkov–Akulov goldstinos on super-Dp-branes?

sources.title: Properties of Nilpotent Supergravity

evidence.text: Can nonlinear supersymmetry and the goldstino arise from a constrained gravitational multiplet, and what restrictions does that gravitational origin impose on matter couplings and inflationary models?

sources.title: Non-linear realisations in global and local supersymmetry

evidence.text: How can constrained superfields systematically describe four-dimensional effective theories with spontaneously broken global or local supersymmetry, chosen light spectra and applications to supergravity and de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: Unimodular vs Nilpotent Superfield Approach to Pure dS Supergravity

evidence.text: Does super-unimodular gravity yield the same pure de Sitter supergravity action as the goldstino-brane/nilpotent-superfield constructions? The paper tests this through cubic order as a step toward understanding possible uniqueness.

sources.title: Obstacles for dS in Supersymmetric Theories

evidence.text: What obstructs controlled de Sitter configurations in supersymmetric effective theories of quantum gravity, through either gauging with charged massless gravitini or nonlinear supersymmetry breaking in an explicit goldstino sector?

sources.title: (Super)universal attractors and the de Sitter vacua in string landscape

evidence.text: Can nilpotent Kähler corrections realize universal inflationary attractors and small positive vacuum energy without requiring a supersymmetric-AdS precursor, while satisfying the gradient de Sitter conjecture?

sources.title: From Linear SUSY to Constrained Superfields

evidence.text: Use constrained chiral superfields while retaining auxiliary fields: XNL² = 0 describes the Goldstino; XNL QNL = 0 removes a matter scalar; a chirality constraint removes the fermion of HNL; XNL(ANL − AbarNL) = 0 retains one real scalar.

sources.title: Metastable spontaneous breaking of N=2 supersymmetry

evidence.text: Compute the Hessian and canonically normalize it using a vielbein. Average the three physical hypermultiplet directions and two vector-sector scalar directions into a two-by-two matrix; its eigenvalues constrain the extremal eigenvalues of the full physical scalar matrix.

sources.title: Cosmology with Nilpotent Superfields

evidence.text: Impose algebraic chiral-superfield constraints with F-term Lagrange multipliers in a superconformal action. N has Weyl weight 2, the superpotential weight 3, and the multiplier weight 1; varying a term Λ(X^(2))² enforces nilpotency while the unsolved action is manifestly supersymmetric.

sources.title: Properties of Nilpotent Supergravity

evidence.text: The component analysis solves the auxiliary-field constraint using nilpotent goldstino bilinears. At quadratic fermion order, gamma traces and divergences of the modified Rarita-Schwinger equation identify constraints; gauging away the composite goldstino recovers the conventional massive-gravitino equation.

sources.title: Non-linear realisations in global and local supersymmetry

evidence.text: Solves supersymmetric constraints by applying superspace derivatives and projecting to components. Grassmann identities and iterative auxiliary-field equations are used to obtain component actions.

sources.title: Unimodular vs Nilpotent Superfield Approach to Pure dS Supergravity

evidence.text: Use nonlinear field redefinitions adapted to transformed boundary conditions, then eliminate auxiliary fields and Lagrange-multiplier modes. Further redefinitions decouple the diffeomorphism Stückelberg field from the fermions.

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractors from supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a small R-symmetric correction to hyperbolic Kähler geometry produce viable sgoldstino inflation while retaining spontaneous supersymmetry and R-symmetry breaking in a Minkowski or de Sitter vacuum?

sources.title: On non-universal Goldstino couplings to matter

evidence.text: How can constrained superfields retain UV-dependent, non-universal goldstino–matter interactions generated by integrating out finite-mass superpartners, rather than describing only universal couplings?

sources.title: de Sitter decay through goldstino evaporation

evidence.text: What microscopic or EFT principle fixes the membrane tension and charge needed for rapid goldstino evaporation? The paper leaves this unresolved and proposes extensions to other constrained three-form multiplets and to inflation.

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: The breaking mechanism is a mismatch between the N=1 supersymmetry selected by the compact orientifold and the N=1 supersymmetry locally preserved by negative conifold flux.

sources.title: Supersymmetric horizons at the edge of effective field theory

evidence.text: Can a single effective supergravity potential connect inflation, metastable de Sitter acceleration, Minkowski crossings and asymptotic supersymmetric AdS, while controlling moduli and large canonical field excursions?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a minimal-supergravity model tie a gravitino mass to an abelian coupling? This example gauges a scalar shift and combines F- and D-term supersymmetry breaking.

sources.title: Anti-brane uplift instability from goldstino condensation

evidence.text: Can goldstino self-interactions generate composite states whose dynamics destabilize the Volkov–Akulov vacuum and the de Sitter critical points obtained from its supergravity and KKLT embeddings?

sources.title: Runaway potentials and a massive goldstino

evidence.text: Does spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on an evolving runaway scalar background give the true shifting goldstino an effective mass, and how does that mass depend on the potential, its slope scale, and mixing with other fermions? The analysis remains agnostic about de Sitter swampland conjectures.

sources.title: A goldstino at the bottom of the cascade

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking backgrounds with KS-type ultraviolet asymptotics pass the supercurrent Ward-identity and goldstino tests for spontaneous breaking, independently of the separate question of infrared stability?

sources.title: Brane induced supersymmetry breaking and de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Can a space-filling goldstino brane provide a geometric formulation of spontaneously broken N=1, D=4 supergravity admitting de Sitter vacua, and how does this formulation relate to constrained superfields?

sources.title: Goldstino superfields in $ \mathcal{N}=2 $ supergravity

evidence.text: How can constrained Goldstino superfields be coupled to off-shell N=2 supergravity and matter to describe spontaneously broken local supersymmetry, including parameter ranges admitting de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Goldstino condensation?

evidence.text: Does the unstable two-unconstrained-superfield model proposed for goldstino condensation continuously approach Volkov–Akulov theory, de Sitter supergravity, or KKLT, thereby establishing an instability in those theories?

sources.title: Stückelberg path to pure de Sitter supergravity

evidence.text: Can the perturbative super-Stückelberg construction of unimodular supergravity be completed to all orders in its compensating fields, restoring full diffeomorphism and local supersymmetry invariance while retaining spontaneously supersymmetry-breaking de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: This setting describes how a hidden source of supersymmetry breaking gravitationally affects a dark-energy scalar, even when the two superpotentials and the initial Kähler potential contain no direct cross terms.

sources.title: Aspects of spontaneously broken N=1 global supersymmetry in the presence of gauge interactions

evidence.text: How do spontaneous supersymmetry-breaking masses constrain goldstino interactions, low-energy scattering, and tree-level unitarity when gauge interactions are present, including cases where supersymmetry and gauge symmetry break together?

sources.title: Pure de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: Can one construct a complete scalar-free component supergravity action and transformation rules coupling the nonlinear Volkov–Akulov Goldstino to gravity, with spontaneously broken local supersymmetry and a de Sitter bosonic solution?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: An explicit STU model tests whether a gravitino mass and an abelian R-symmetry coupling vanish together along continuous scalar directions.

sources.title: Who's Afraid of the Supersymmetric Dark? The Standard Model vs Low-Energy Supergravity

evidence.text: Can a light, approximately supersymmetric gravity sector retain its supergravity scalar-potential structure after heavy non-supersymmetric Standard Model particles are integrated out, and what does consistent coupling to such matter imply?
